label: asis
limits_note: As-is (IdeaPad-era) limits, each protocol ramp started from a fresh ClickHouse restart: load receiver 256 MiB, load writer 512 MiB, ClickHouse 2 GiB container / 1.5 GiB max_server_memory_usage, Redpanda --smp=1 --memory=1536M (2 GiB container).

hardware.shared_machine: Generator and pipeline share one host. Generator pinned to core 0 (taskset); load receiver/writer, ClickHouse and Redpanda pinned to cores 1-3 (docker cpuset). Host processes (dockerd, tailscaled, sshd, ...) are unpinned and may run on any core.
